ambrosiana-trotti22-7r-7v.summary: Biglia answers reproaches for a bad start to the negotiation that offended the Emperor; the offer of 4,000 foot or 2,000 horse; a person of the Emperor's blood as their head; Zasius and Weber of the privy council dine with him and speak of the connubio.
ambrosiana-trotti22-7r-7v.en:
The {reproofs} that [Your Lordship] sends me — that I have made a bad {beginning} of the negotiation here, and that His Majesty has remained offended — I receive as a loving reminder, and I give you for them the greatest thanks I can; {but} my will is already to die {rather} than offend {His Majesty}: {this} is what I care for most, more than any {harm} that could befall me ‹…›, and it is what burns and torments my soul. I can do nothing now but {beg} ‹…› ‹…›; for my part I {shall} also do this: take care to assure {His Majesty} that truly ‹…› ‹…› ‹…› for which I am {reproved} and in which I would have {erred}.

As to the connubio, I know well that, if he {remains} satisfied with {His Majesty}, to this ‹…› shows very little satisfaction towards the ‹…›.

system: Numerical syllabic cipher: single digits = vowel or bare consonant, two digits = row consonant + column vowel, a few codes (59 qua, 97 che, 19 per) and a small nomenclator; words separated by 00
